name: Yan Drawing
tagline: Software engineer turned artist. Portraits, urban sketches and fashion illustration in New York.
bio: I spent years as a software engineer at Airbnb, then went all in on drawing. I sketch New York as it happens: street corners, cafés and the people in them. I also draw portraits and fashion illustration. Book me to draw your guests at a wedding, or sit for a relaxed portrait of your own.
terms: Dates are held with a deposit. Free to reschedule up to 14 days before.

experiences.name: Live portraits at your wedding
experiences.desc: I draw your guests during cocktail hour or the reception, one quick portrait at a time, and each guest takes theirs home. A keepsake people actually keep.
includes: Ink-and-wash portraits of your guests, about 5 minutes each
Archival paper and a sleeve for each one
A portrait of the two of you, finished after the day
experiences.setup: A small table and two chairs somewhere with good light.

experiences.name: Casual portrait sitting
experiences.desc: A relaxed sitting in a café, a park or your place. Come alone, as a couple or with a friend. You leave with an original drawing.
includes: An original portrait in pencil, charcoal or ink
A quick sketch to choose the pose before we start

experiences.name: Live fashion illustration at your launch
experiences.desc: I illustrate your guests and the looks in the room at a launch, pop-up or party, and they walk away with a drawing.
includes: Quick fashion illustrations of your guests
Paper with your logo or event name, if you'd like
experiences.branding: Your logo or event name on the paper. Needs 2 weeks.
